errors_encountered.error: Here EV API returns generic 'Trạm sạc VinFast' for all stations, wiping out authentic evcs.vn station names during polling
errors_encountered.solution: Preserve authentic non-generic target.name in pollOnce() and resolve generic names with EvcsStationNameResolver

errors_encountered.error: Google Maps geo:0,0?q=... preview pin screen required extra tap on 'Bắt đầu'
errors_encountered.solution: Dispatch direct turn-by-turn intent google.navigation:q=lat,lon&mode=d with Maps package target

decisions_made.reason: Prevents redundant network queries when polling or evaluating multiple nearby candidates
Allows resolving station names even if Here EV API uses a proprietary UUID rather than evcs.vn location ID (<= 100m match)
